if ayanelust10 == True:
scene ayanekirinchristmas1

A girl who had been filled with Christmas joy just moments ago stands beside an overpriced plasma-screen TV and ponders over how to get herself out of the [[very] uncomfortable situation she’s suddenly found herself in.
lines.zh: 一个几分钟前还满溢着圣诞喜悦的女孩，站在一台贵得离谱的等离子电视旁，思索着该怎么从自己突然陷入的 [[very] 尴尬处境里脱身。

lines.en: If we were to put things in Molly’s terms, which we might as well do since she is currently scouring the halls for a vending machine, it’s almost like there's some sort of dark entity lurking between them.
lines.zh: 如果我们用 Molly 的说法来讲——反正她这会儿正在走廊里四处搜寻自动贩卖机，不妨就这么说——那就像是有某种黑暗实体潜伏在她们之间。

lines.en: And no, the dark entity is not in reference to Ayane’s shadow which is {i}literally{/i} in between the two of them.
lines.zh: 不，这个黑暗实体指的不是 Ayane 的影子——虽然它{i}字面意义上{/i}确实夹在她们两个中间。

lines.en: It’s a reference to how these girls, who may or may not have been “friends” up until recently, are now miles apart emotionally but only two or so feet between each other physically.
lines.zh: 它指的是，这些也许直到最近还算是「朋友」的女孩，如今在情感上相隔万里，物理上却只隔着两英尺左右。

lines.en: Though, Ayane will gladly accept two feet over attached and half-nude alongside the man she’s grown to love in recent years.
lines.zh: 不过，比起和她近年来爱上的那个男人黏在一起、衣衫半解，Ayane 倒是很乐意接受这两英尺。

lines.en: : Hey. I like your scarf.
lines.zh: : 嘿。我喜欢你的围巾。

lines.en: : Did Sensei buy it for you? I saw Ami and Maya had similar ones as well.
lines.zh: : Sensei 给你买的吗？我看到 Ami 和 Maya 也有差不多的。

lines.en: : I bought it for myself so I could match them.
lines.zh: : 我自己买的，好跟她们配成一对。

lines.en: : Sensei bought the other two.
lines.zh: : 另外两条是 Sensei 买的。

lines.en: : Really? That’s kinda sus.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那有点可疑啊。

lines.en: : Isn’t he supposed to be your boyfriend or whatever?
lines.zh: : 他不是应该当你男朋友什么的吗？

lines.en: : He’s not my boyfriend. I just like him.
lines.zh: : 他不是我男朋友。我只是喜欢他。

lines.en: : I’ve told you this how many times now?
lines.zh: : 这话我都跟你说过多少遍了？

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas2
: Wait, you guys {i}still{/i} aren’t dating? Even after giving him your virginity?
lines.zh: : 等等，你们{i}还{/i}没在交往？连初夜都给他了？

lines.en: : What the hell is taking so long?
lines.zh: : 到底还在磨蹭什么？

lines.en: : You should probably be more careful about who you give yourself to if that’s the case, though.
lines.zh: : 不过既然是这样，你大概该更小心挑把自己交给谁。

lines.en: : All guys care about is sex, so there’s always a chance he could just be using you or something like that.
lines.zh: : 男人满脑子只有性，所以总有可能是他在利用你什么的。

lines.en: : He {i}was{/i} kinda crazy hard when he was screwing you, so it’s definitely possible.
lines.zh: : 他肏你的时候{i}确实{/i}硬得有点离谱，所以这种可能性绝对有。

lines.en: : Not like it matters to me or anything, but yeah.
lines.zh: : 反正跟我没什么关系，不过是啊。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas3
: What do you want, Kirin?...
lines.zh: : 你想干什么，Kirin？……

lines.en: : I obviously don’t want to talk to you, so it’s probably best if you mind your own fucking business.
lines.zh: : 我显然不想跟你说话，所以你最好他妈少管闲事。

lines.en: : Not like it matters to me or anything, but yeah.
lines.zh: : 反正跟我没什么关系，不过是啊。

lines.en: : Hey, now! No reason to get all toxic, Ayane. I’m just chatting with an old friend at a party.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这么大火气嘛，Ayane。我只是在派对上跟老朋友聊聊天。

lines.en: : That’s what friends do, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 朋友不就是这么做的吗？

lines.en: : Yup. And that’s how I’m sure tonight would have went if you never pulled that stunt at the beach.
lines.zh: : 对。而我也确信，要是你没在海边搞出那一出，今晚本来就会是这样。

lines.en: : Do you think that’s how friends are supposed to act with each other?
lines.zh: : 你觉得朋友之间该那样相处吗？

lines.en: : I told you something in confidence and you used it against me.
lines.zh: : 我把一件事当秘密告诉了你，你却拿它来对付我。

lines.en: : Hey, all I did was stumble across two people fucking each other. How is that pulling a stunt?
lines.zh: : 嘿，我不过是撞见两个人正在肏对方。这怎么就成了搞事了？

lines.en: : You started it. Just try not getting horny at a moment’s notice and things like that won’t happen.
lines.zh: : 是你先开始的。只要别动不动就发情，这种事就不会发生。

lines.en: : Kirin...leave me alone.
lines.zh: : Kirin……别烦我。

lines.en: : Hmmm, all these negative feelings must be why I wasn’t invited to your Halloween party.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你这些负面情绪，大概就是我没被邀请去你万圣节派对的原因吧。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas4
: {i}You’d think after sharing a dick, the two of us would have become closer. Am I right?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你说，共用过一根鸡巴之后，我们两个本该更亲近才对。我说得没错吧？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Like, how many other girls here can say you grinded on their hand? We’re kind of super close, whether you like it or not.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}说起来，这儿有几个女孩能说你在她们手上蹭过？不管你愿不愿意，我们算是超级亲密了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Please...go away...{/i}
: But everyone else here is so boring.
lines.zh: : 可这儿其他人都太无聊了。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas5
: Wanna see if Sensei has some free time to take us downstairs and-
lines.zh: : 想不想看看 Sensei 有没有空带我们下楼去——

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas6
: Kirin! They have pancakes here!
lines.zh: : Kirin！这儿有松饼！

lines.en: : ...Yeah? And?
lines.zh: : ……嗯？那又怎样？

lines.en: : You love pancakes! And these ones are really good!
lines.zh: : 你最爱吃松饼啊！而且这些真的很好吃！

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas7
: Didn’t you just fucking eat before we came here?! Shouldn’t you be watching your weight?
lines.zh: : 我们出发前你不是他妈刚吃过吗？！你不是该注意体重吗？

lines.en: : No way! It’s Christmas!
lines.zh: : 才不要！今天是圣诞节！

lines.en: : Here, come eat some!
lines.zh: : 来，过来吃点！

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas8
: I DON’T WANT ANY FUCKING PANCAKES, KARIN! LEAVE ME ALONE!
lines.zh: : 我他妈一点都不想吃松饼，KARIN！别烦我！

lines.en: else:
scene ayanekirinchristmas9
Two girls meet beside an overpriced plasma-screen TV and greet each other in kind because that’s what friends do.
lines.zh: 两个女孩在一台贵得离谱的等离子电视旁相遇，友好地互相问候，因为朋友就是这么做的。

lines.en: They greet each other.
lines.zh: 她们互相问候。

lines.en: Hello. How are you doing?
lines.zh: 你好。最近过得怎么样？

lines.en: Have you been enjoying the weather lately?
lines.zh: 最近天气还不错吧？

lines.en: These are not things they actually say, but moreso just examples of things that you, a real human being, can say if you ever find yourself in front of a plasma-screen TV with a person you’re kind of cool with.
lines.zh: 这些其实不是她们真说的话，而更像是一些例子——你，一个真正的人类，万一哪天和一位还算合得来的人一起站在等离子电视前，可以说的那些话。

lines.en: But these two, being several steps beyond conversing about the weather, decide to talk about the one thing they have in common more than anything else-
lines.zh: 不过这两个人早已超越了聊天气的阶段，决定谈谈她们共同点最多的那一件事——

lines.en: Their love for Christmas.
lines.zh: 她们对圣诞节的爱。

lines.en: : Hey! Long time, no see.
lines.zh: : 嘿！好久不见。

lines.en: : Was starting to think I’d go the whole winter break without running into you.
lines.zh: : 我还以为整个寒假都碰不上你呢。

lines.en: : You have my number, you know? You could always ask me to hang out when I’m not doing anything.
lines.zh: : 你有我的号码啊，你知道的？我闲着的时候你随时可以约我出来玩。

lines.en: : True, true. But I figured with it being the holiday season and all, you’d probably be spending a little more time with you-know-who.
lines.zh: : 是是是。不过我想，毕竟是过节嘛，你大概会多花点时间陪那个你懂的人。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas10
: No...not much more time than normal.
lines.zh: : 没有……跟平时差不多。

lines.en: : He’s got a lot of other girls who are important to him, so it’s not like he can {i}only{/i} spend time with me, whether I want him to or not.
lines.zh: : 对他来说重要的女孩有一大堆，所以不管我想不想，他都不可能{i}只{/i}陪我一个人。

lines.en: : You sure you’re okay with that? Guys tend to only think about what they can stick their dick inside, don’t they?
lines.zh: : 你真能接受吗？男人不就只想着把鸡巴往哪儿塞吗？

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas11
: Sensei isn’t like that. He’s kind and compassionate and actually cares about everyone.
lines.zh: : Sensei 不是那种人。他善良、体贴，是真的在乎每一个人。

lines.en: : You should try actually getting to know him sometime.
lines.zh: : 你该试着真正去了解他一次。

lines.en: : I’m sure he seems like just another guy, but he really is a special person.
lines.zh: : 我敢说他看起来跟别的男人没什么两样，但他真的是个特别的人。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas12
: I already know him pretty well...But how come you’re gettin’ all sappy all of a sudden?...
lines.zh: : 我跟他已经挺熟了……不过你怎么突然变得这么多愁善感？……

lines.en: : That’s not really like you.
lines.zh: : 这可不像你。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas13
: Because it’s Christmas!
lines.zh: : 因为今天是圣诞节啊！

lines.en: : We’re supposed to be saying sappy stuff to each other and spreading around all of the Christmas joy!
lines.zh: : 我们就该对彼此说些肉麻的话，把圣诞的喜悦到处散播！

lines.en: : Umm...well, I mean, I like Christmas too...but I’m not really a fan of all that sentimental stuff.
lines.zh: : 呃……嗯，我也挺喜欢圣诞节的啦……不过我不太吃那一套感伤的东西。

lines.en: : I kind of just like being able to eat disgusting amounts of chicken without anyone judging me.
lines.zh: : 我只是喜欢能面不改色地吃掉海量炸鸡，还没人评判我。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas14
: But...I guess it {i}is{/i} kind of nice getting attention and stuff too.
lines.zh: : 不过……被人关注什么的，{i}确实{/i}也挺好的。

lines.en: : My grandma normally comes over around this time of year and always gives me money and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我奶奶一般每年这时候会过来，总会给我钱什么的。

lines.en: : Not like you’d care, though, little miss black-card.
lines.zh: : 不过你大概不在乎吧，黑卡大小姐。

lines.en: : See? This is exactly the kind of stuff we’re supposed to be talking about- the things that make us happy.
lines.zh: : 你看？我们本来就该聊这些——那些让我们开心的事。

lines.en: : My mom always liked Western Christmases when I was growing up, but this was back before the bubble wrap thing.
lines.zh: : 我妈妈在我小的时候一直很喜欢西式圣诞节，不过那是气泡纸事件之前的事了。

lines.en: : So we’d always wake up early in the morning and open the few presents we were able to get for each other and then spend the entire day together.
lines.zh: : 我们总是早早起床，拆开几件好不容易为对方准备的礼物，然后一整天都待在一起。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas15
: Things aren’t like that anymore.
lines.zh: : 现在不一样了。

lines.en: : But at least now I have other special people to spend the day with.
lines.zh: : 不过至少现在我还有别的特别的人可以一起过这一天。

lines.en: : And even if it’s not a “traditional” Christmas in the sense I’m used to, it’s something I wouldn't mind becoming tradition.
lines.zh: : 就算按我习惯的意义来说，这不算「传统」的圣诞节，我也不介意让它成为新的传统。

lines.en: : As long as I can continue to be around Sen...{i}everyone{/i}, I’m sure there will be plenty of Christmas memories to be made that are just as good as the old ones.
lines.zh: : 只要我还能继续待在 Sen……{i}大家{/i}身边，我敢肯定，以后一定能创造出和过去一样美好的圣诞回忆。

lines.en: : You got laid last night didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你昨晚被人肏了吧？

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas16
: Wha-?!
: Kirin!
lines.zh: : Kirin！

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 怎么？

lines.en: : You smell like you got laid.
lines.zh: : 你身上有股被人肏过的味道。

lines.en: : What does that have to do with Christmas?!
lines.zh: : 这跟圣诞节有什么关系？！

lines.en: : Idunno. You were talkin’ about making new memories and stuff so I kinda just figured you meant you were getting Christmas-style boned all night.
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊。你在说什么创造新回忆什么的，我就自然以为你是在说被圣诞式地肏了一整晚。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas17
: What would doing it...Christmas-style even entail?...
lines.zh: : 那个……「圣诞式」到底是什么样的？……

lines.en: : I don’t know. Maybe you were dressed like an elf? Could mean anything.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。也许你穿得像个小精灵？什么都有可能。

lines.en: : Didn’t you sleep over at Ami’s place, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你不是在 Ami 家过夜吗？

lines.en: : Did you really fuck her [uncle] while she was around? That’s kind of sick, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你真当着她的面肏了她[uncle]？这也太变态了吧，Ayane。

lines.en: : You’re even bolder than I thought you were.
lines.zh: : 你比我想的还要大胆。

lines.en: : N-Nothing like that happened! I slept in the bed with Ami and Maya. You can ask either of them...
lines.zh: : 才、才没有那种事！我和 Ami、Maya 一起睡在床上的。你可以去问她们任何一个……

lines.en: : Hmm...well, either way, I hope you get to make some {i}Christmas memories{/i} soon, if you catch my drift.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不管怎样，我希望你能早点制造一些{i}圣诞回忆{/i}，懂我意思吧。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas18
: Just make sure the coast is clear if you do. Wouldn’t want Ami or somebody catchin’ you in the act, now would you?
lines.zh: : 真要做的话记得先确认周围没人。你总不想被 Ami 什么的当场抓包吧？

lines.en: : I...have no idea what you’re talking about...
lines.zh: : 我……完全不知道你在说什么……

lines.en: scene black
scene ayanekirinchristmas19
: Hey. Why are you guys sitting on a bed with two swans kissing behind you?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你们俩为什么坐在床上，背后还有两只天鹅在接吻？

lines.en: : We were actually just talking about that.
lines.zh: : 我们刚才正好在聊这个。

lines.en: : Please don’t draw any more attention to it. It’s a hurdle Ami and I have overcome as best friends.
lines.zh: : 请别再引起更多注意了。这是我和 Ami 作为最好的朋友一起跨过的一道坎。

lines.en: : I will not draw any attention to it as long as Maya helps me with something.
lines.zh: : 只要 Maya 帮我一个忙，我就不再提了。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas20
: Maya? What do you need her help with?
lines.zh: : Maya？你需要她帮什么忙？

lines.en: : Yeah, what? Why am I suddenly involved?
lines.zh: : 对啊，什么？我怎么突然就被卷进来了？

lines.en: : All we did was walk here together. You don’t think this means we’re close now, do you?
lines.zh: : 我们只是一起走过来的而已。你不会觉得这就代表我们变亲近了吧？

lines.en: : Go ask Ayane. I’m sure she’s willing to help.
lines.zh: : 去问 Ayane 啊。我肯定她很乐意帮忙。

lines.en: : Probably {i}too{/i} willing. Ask me instead.
lines.zh: : 大概{i}太{/i}乐意了。问我吧。

lines.en: : Fine, then. Ami, who did I have for Secret Santa?
lines.zh: : 那好吧。Ami，我的神秘圣诞老人是谁？

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas21
: You didn’t get your Secret Santa a present?!
lines.zh: : 你没给你的神秘圣诞老人准备礼物？！

lines.en: : How could you do this?! You’re literally ruining Christmas for the rest of our lives!
lines.zh: : 你怎么能这样？！你这是要毁掉我们往后余生的圣诞节啊！

lines.en: : That’s a little dramatic, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 这说得有点夸张了吧？

lines.en: : Not at all!
lines.zh: : 一点都不！

lines.en: : And why would Maya even know who you have? That’s something you’re supposed to keep track of yourself so the surprise isn’t ruined.
lines.zh: : 再说了，Maya 怎么会知道你抽到谁？这种事本来就该你自己记着，免得惊喜被破坏。

lines.en: : She’s right.
lines.zh: : 她说得对。

lines.en: : There’s no way for me to know who you’d have. You never told me.
lines.zh: : 我没办法知道你抽到了谁。你从来没告诉过我。

lines.en: : You’re probably just misremembering something.
lines.zh: : 你大概是记错了什么。

lines.en: : Wait, really? I could have sworn I {i}told you{/i}.
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？我明明记得我{i}告诉过你{/i}。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas22
: Again, I have no idea.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，我不知道。

lines.en: : The only way to find out is by waiting until the end of the night and then disappointing someone.
lines.zh: : 唯一的办法就是等到今晚结束，然后让某个人失望。

lines.en: : But I’m sure you’re already used to disappointing everyone, so that won’t come with much difficulty for you.
lines.zh: : 不过我敢说你早就习惯让所有人失望了，所以这对你来说应该不难。

lines.en: : You always know exactly what to say to cheer me up, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你总是知道该说什么来让我振作，是吧？

lines.en: : Of course. Just like you always know exactly how to annoy me.
lines.zh: : 当然。就像你总是知道该怎么惹我烦一样。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas23
: Listening to you two is kind of like listening to a pair of divorced senior citizens.
lines.zh: : 听你们两个说话，有点像在听一对离婚的老头老太太。

lines.en: : No it isn’t because that implies that the two of us would have had to have been romantically involved at some point.
lines.zh: : 才不是，因为那意味着我们两个曾经有过一段恋情。

lines.en: : Yeah, and I’d never divorce Maya. Even if all she does is insult me. That’s just part of her charm.
lines.zh: : 是啊，而且我永远不会跟 Maya 离婚。就算她只会骂我。那也是她魅力的一部分。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas24
: Why are you still here? Shouldn’t you be out buying a generic present for whoever your Secret Santa is?
lines.zh: : 你怎么还在这儿？你不是该出去给你的神秘圣诞老人买份普普通通的礼物吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, if you didn’t get anything, you’re either going to need to go buy something right now or just give something you have on you to your Santa person.
lines.zh: : 对啊，要是你什么都没准备，你要么现在就去买点什么，要么就把身上带的东西给你那个圣诞老人。

lines.en: : I didn’t even think of that...
lines.zh: : 我都没想到这个……

lines.en: A generic gift might just be crazy enough to work as long as I can find something...serviceable.
lines.zh: 只要我能找到点……能用得上的东西，一份普普通通的礼物说不定还真能行得通。

lines.en: I’m dealing with a bunch of [teenage]girls here. Buying a generic present is probably as easy as buying a bottle of perfume or something along those lines.
lines.zh: 我这儿对付的是一群[teenage]女孩。买份普通礼物大概就跟买瓶香水什么的差不多容易。

lines.en: But...perfume can be kind of expensive.
lines.zh: 不过……香水可能有点贵。

lines.en: Let’s see what I have in my pockets.
lines.zh: 看看我口袋里有什么吧。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas25
: Now what?...
lines.zh: : 又怎么了？……

lines.en: : What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？

lines.en: : You’re not looking through your pockets to see if there’s anything you could give someone, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会是在翻口袋，看有没有什么东西能送人吧？

lines.en: : Leave me alone. I have my methods.
lines.zh: : 别管我。我自有办法。

lines.en: : You’re not just disgusting. You’re a complete idiot.
lines.zh: : 你不只是恶心。你还是个彻头彻尾的白痴。

lines.en: : Do you think...700 Yen would be a good present?
lines.zh: : 你们觉得……700 日元算个好礼物吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不算。

lines.en: : Our limit was 2,000 Yen.
lines.zh: : 我们的上限是 2,000 日元。

lines.en: : Yeah but that’s just a limit. You can go under that as long as the present has some sort of emotional value.
lines.zh: : 是没错，可那只是个上限。只要礼物有某种情感价值，低于上限也行。

lines.en: : And I’m sure the coins you just pulled out of your pockets and picked lint off of are just teeming with emotional value.
lines.zh: : 我敢说你刚从口袋里掏出来、还把绒毛摘掉的那些硬币，一定饱含着情感价值呢。

lines.en: : You have no idea how much these coins mean to me, Maya.
lines.zh: : 你根本不知道这些硬币对我有多重要，Maya。

lines.en: : They mean literally nothing. You’re trying to pass them off as presents.
lines.zh: : 它们根本一钱不值。你在试图把它们当礼物送出去。

lines.en: : You probably didn’t even know you had them until thirty seconds ago.
lines.zh: : 大概三十秒前你才刚知道自己身上有这些钱。

lines.en: : Fine. I’ll go buy an actual present.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我去买份真正的礼物。

lines.en: : But I won’t be happy about it.
lines.zh: : 不过我不会高兴的。

lines.en: : You’re never really happy about anything, so that’s probably fine.
lines.zh: : 你从来就没真的高兴过，所以大概也没关系。

lines.en: : I’ll be back.
lines.zh: : 我回来了再说。

lines.en: : Okay, but don’t get lost. It’s kind of a big hotel.
lines.zh: : 好，不过别走丢了。这酒店挺大的。

lines.en: : No, it’s fine. You can get lost.
lines.zh: : 不，没关系。你走丢吧。

lines.en: : You will not be missed.
lines.zh: : 没人会想你的。

lines.en: : I’ll definitely be back...
lines.zh: : 我肯定会回来的……

lines.en: scene black
I make my way to the door, hoping I’m able to find a gift shop or something similar downstairs.
lines.zh: 我朝门口走去，盼着能在楼下找到礼品店之类的。

lines.en: Of course, though, I’m met with another five-foot obstacle as soon as I get to the door.
lines.zh: 当然，我刚走到门口，就又撞上了一道五英尺高的障碍。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas26
: Is everything okay, Sir? You appear to be in a rush.
lines.zh: : 一切都还好吗，先生？您看起来很着急。

lines.en: : If you are low on mana, I’ve just placed an entire satchel worth of potions on the-
lines.zh: : 如果您的魔力不足，我刚把整整一挎包的药水放在了——

lines.en: : Molly, I’m in a hurry.
lines.zh: : Molly，我有急事。

lines.en: : A hurry for what? What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 急什么？出什么事了？

lines.en: : Something big. And serious.
lines.zh: : 大事。而且很严重。

lines.en: : Big?...Serious?
lines.zh: : 大事？……严重？

lines.en: : Just...come with me. I’ll show you.
lines.zh: : 就……跟我来。我给你看。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas27
: H-Hold on a second, Sir! You need to show me something {i}big{/i} and {i}serious{/i} right now?!
lines.zh: : 先、先等一下，先生！您现在要给我看什么{i}大{/i}而{i}严肃{/i}的东西？！

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how something like that sounds to a girl who’s played as much eroge as me?!
lines.zh: : 您知不知道，这种话在我这种玩过那么多 eroge 的女孩听来像什么？！

lines.en: : Are you coming or not? I really don’t have time to deal with your ramblings right now.
lines.zh: : 你到底来不来？我现在真没工夫听你唠叨。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas28
: I-If you’re going to p-p-pressure me, the least you can do is hear my concerns!
lines.zh: : 既、既然您要逼我，那至少请您听听我的顾虑！

lines.en: : I’m not ready for this to go where it’s going in my head!
lines.zh: : 我还没做好心理准备，让事情往我脑子里想的那个方向发展！

lines.en: scene black
I grab Molly by the wrist and pull her out of the hotel room.
lines.zh: 我一把抓住 Molly 的手腕，把她拉出了酒店房间。

lines.en: Someone like her finding out I forgot my Secret Santa present probably won’t be as demeaning as someone like Makoto or even Chika finding out.
lines.zh: 让她这样的人知道我忘了神秘圣诞老人的礼物，大概不会像让 Makoto 或者连 Chika 知道那样丢脸。

lines.en: If anything, I feel like Molly might actually be a good person to help me pick something out.
lines.zh: 要说的话，我觉得 Molly 说不定真是帮我挑东西的好人选。

lines.en: : S-Sir! Your strength level far surpasses mine!
lines.zh: : 先、先生！您的力量值远远超过我！

lines.en: : My wrist is being critically injured and all of the medkits are upstairs!
lines.zh: : 我的手腕正受到致命伤害，而所有的医疗包都在楼上！

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas29
: I never thought my first time would be in a hotel gift shop on Christmas day.
lines.zh: : 我从没想过我的第一次会是在圣诞节的酒店礼品店里。

lines.en: : Is this even legal?
lines.zh: : 这甚至合法吗？

lines.en: : If you still think this is something sexual after coming all the way here, you’re even more hopeless than I am.
lines.zh: : 走了这么远的路过来，你要是还觉得这是那种事，那你比我还无可救药。

lines.en: : Well then what is it? What is this confounded side-quest that has pulled me from the main story chain once more?
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么？是什么该死的支线任务，又一次把我从主线剧情里拽了出来？

lines.en: : I forgot a...key item. Or something.
lines.zh: : 我忘了一件……关键道具。之类的。

lines.en: : A key item? But the only key items required for tonight’s mission are-
lines.zh: : 关键道具？可今晚任务所需的关键道具只有——

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas30
: You forgot to buy a present!
lines.zh: : 您忘了买礼物！

lines.en: : Wow, you picked up on that faster than I thought.
lines.zh: : 哇，你比我想的更快反应过来。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas31
: This is even more serious than I imagined...
lines.zh: : 这比我想象的还要严重……

lines.en: : Up until five seconds ago, you thought we were about to have sex.
lines.zh: : 五秒钟前你还以为我们要上床呢。

lines.en: : Sex is temporary. Christmas is forever.
lines.zh: : 性是一时的。圣诞节是永远的。

lines.en: : No it’s not. It’s 24 hours long.
lines.zh: : 才不是。它就 24 小时长。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas32
: Well...who are you shopping for exactly?
lines.zh: : 那么……您具体是在给谁买东西？

lines.en: : I...don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道。

lines.en: : So you’re trying to farm an item for a quest before you even pick it up? How can you be sure you’ll get the right one?
lines.zh: : 所以您是想在还没接任务之前就去刷道具？您怎么能保证刷到对的那一个？

lines.en: : I can't. That’s exactly why I need your help.
lines.zh: : 我不能。这正是我需要你帮忙的原因。

lines.en: : I need you to help me choose something that any girl in class would like so that, when I find out who I’m supposed to give this to, it will go over well.
lines.zh: : 我需要你帮我挑一个班上任何女孩都会喜欢的东西，这样等我知道该送给谁的时候，效果就会很好。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas33
: Hmm...I see. I see.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我明白了。我明白了。

lines.en: : Luckily for you- I, Molly MacCormack, am an expert when it comes to winning the hearts of [teenage]girls.
lines.zh: : 算您走运——我，Molly MacCormack，在赢得[teenage]女孩芳心这方面可是专家。

lines.en: : I’ll have you know I’ve fully completed nearly every VN CG gallery on my computer, so it’s safe to say I’m kind of an expert when it comes to things like this.
lines.zh: : 我得让您知道，我电脑上几乎所有 VN 的 CG 图鉴都全收集了，所以说到这种事，我算是专家。

lines.en: : What [teenage]girls want more than material goods is an {i}experience{/i}, Sir.
lines.zh: : [teenage]女孩比起物质，更想要的是一种{i}体验{/i}，先生。

lines.en: : Cool. What {i}experience{/i} can I buy with 2,000 Yen?
lines.zh: : 酷。那 2,000 日元能买到什么{i}体验{/i}？

lines.en: : Heheh~ You can thank me later, as you won’t even need that much.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿～您回头再谢我也不迟，因为您根本用不着那么多钱。

lines.en: : And perhaps...you won’t even need to thank me at all.
lines.zh: : 而且也许……您连谢都不用谢。

lines.en: : Perhaps the experience itself will be fated to be my own.
lines.zh: : 也许那份体验本身就注定属于我。

lines.en: : And it won’t ruin the surprise if the present winds up being for you?
lines.zh: : 如果礼物最后是你，也不会破坏惊喜吗？

lines.en: : Not at all. For this particular experience is sure to move the heart of any [teenage]girl.
lines.zh: : 一点都不会。因为这份体验必定能打动任何一位[teenage]女孩的心。

lines.en: : And I thank you for giving out an opportunity to make this [young_girl]’s dreams come true, Sir!
lines.zh: : 而我也感谢您给我这个机会，让这位[young_girl]的梦想成真，先生！

lines.en: : Sure, Molly. Just point out whatever thing you want me to buy and we can get back upstairs.
lines.zh: : 行吧，Molly。你指一下想让我买什么，我们就上楼去。

lines.en: scene ayanekirinchristmas34
: It would be my pleasure...
lines.zh: : 这是我的荣幸……

lines.en: scene black
Molly immediately hoists a white bottle into the air as if it’s some sort of sacred sword or whatever it is warriors typically hold up in fantasy movies.
lines.zh: Molly 立刻把一个白色瓶子高高举起，像是举着某种圣剑，或者奇幻电影里战士通常会举起的随便什么东西。

lines.en: I initially think she’s trying to buy alcohol but it looks like it’s...just an empty bottle?
lines.zh: 我一开始以为她是要买酒，可它看起来……就是个空瓶子？

lines.en: Maybe it's just a weirdly shaped...vase or something?
lines.zh: 也许那只是个形状奇怪的……花瓶什么的？

lines.en: Is that a thing girls like?
lines.zh: 女孩子喜欢那种东西吗？

lines.en: Either way, it’s not like I have time to debate this right now, so I’ll just have to trust her judgement and see how things play out.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我现在没时间争论这个，只能相信她的判断，看事情怎么发展。

lines.en: At least I know she’ll appreciate the strange bottle if I wind up having to give it to her.
lines.zh: 至少我知道，万一最后得把那个奇怪的瓶子送给她，她会很领情的。

lines.en: $ christmas4 = True
$ molly_love += 1
{i}Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Molly 的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]!{/i}
